snippet.title: ClickCrafter Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcement trailer for ClickCrafter, a cozy incremental crafting game where you are stripped of your physical form on a mystical island... your only way out is to work with its cryptic guardian. Is the island guiding you home, or does it have other plans? Master mana, build & craft arcane repairs, and forge a connection with the island to reclaim yourself and uncover its secrets.

Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://onewinter.net/cc/y

Music: Wishing Well by @PurrpleCat.
